title: Knight
html:
Shadowspawn Knight

The origin of Knights and Felknights are a mystery. It is said that they are the spirits of fallen warriors who were consumed by bitterness over their death, and so are unable to leave this world; instead doomed to haunt it till time's end.

Race: Revenant

Class: Fighter

Tip: They usually come in groups, and like to surround the character. This makes them especially vulnerable to AoE attacks.

Basic Types
